verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never mentions official SDKs or client libraries for building against Elastic Observability. The closest items are the APM language agents (Java, Go) and the EDOT OpenTelemetry distributions. Those are instrumentation and collection components, an adjacent capability rather than SDKs a developer programs against, and the OpenAPI probe returned 404 on every path.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
